dispositions.description: All v1-critical tracks remain below M6 and retain track-specific evidence gates.
External operator/user reproduction remains mandatory for beta, RC and stable-v1.
The 90-day/three-cycle beta requirement and 30-day exact-RC soak remain incomplete.
Signed preservation acceptance and the accountable tier-specific release decision remain pending.
National service, facility, network and performance claims are disabled until their archives and measurements exist.

non_claims: Agent-panel recommendations do not resolve P0/P1 evidence gates or approve a release.
No P0 or P1 defect is silently waived by this record.
A deferred-scope item is not a negative finding about the disabled claim.
